summary: Full regression testing of BidVex checkout and payment flows. Tested webhook security, subscription endpoints, Buy Now flow, Auction Winner flow, tax calculations, and seller endpoints. All 51 tests passed (26 new + 25 from iteration 76).

minor.issue: Price field returns string display format instead of integer cents - inconsistent with typical API design but functional

critical_code_review_comments: Webhook security: Correctly rejects requests without stripe-signature header (400) and with invalid signatures (400)
Subscription checkout: Creates valid Stripe checkout sessions with correct price_id
Buy Now flow: Server-side price calculation working correctly with buyer premium, GST/QST, and processing fee
Auction Winner flow: Late penalty calculation and status validation working correctly
Tax endpoints: Quebec tax rates (GST 5%, QST 9.975%) correctly returned
seed_data_creation: Used existing test data from iteration 76: test-buy-now-auction-76, test-winner-listing-76
context_for_next_testing_agent: All payment and webhook endpoints tested. Test data IDs: test-buy-now-auction-76, test-winner-listing-76, test-already-paid-listing-76. Admin user ID: 8940074d-da97-43ca-9a0b-c59d39411ed6. Webhook security tests confirm signature validation is working. Subscription tiers: free, premium ($180/yr), partner_pro ($240/yr), vip ($300/yr).
